title: Physical Trial PTRA/QROT Accepted-Window Binding
goal: Qualify the runtime-owned seam that binds the exact potential-transpiration rate and the exact root-extraction rate physically applied to one Richards trial to F-WOF34 trial scratch, then admits that contribution only after the same F-KT checkpoint lineage/revision/interval has actually committed.

source_bound_inputs.PTRA_semantics: root_water_uptake_request_t.potential_transpiration and the restricted qualified F-WOF18 current reference-ET result producer
source_bound_inputs.QROT_semantics: sum of the exact fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t.root_extraction_sink vector supplied to the Richards trial; this equals root_water_uptake_flux_result_t.actual_uptake_total on the qualified process route
source_bound_inputs.physical_sink_application: the serialized reference backend binds the supplied root_extraction_sink before advancing Richards and the B1.10 root-sink provider returns it unchanged

questions: Where can trial-local PTRA/QROT scratch be prepared without changing the physical forcing actually used by Richards?
How is the exact same F-KT checkpoint used for both the physical candidate and F-WOF34 trial provenance?
How are rejected, mass-incomplete, invalid-candidate and commit-rejected paths guaranteed to contribute zero?

How is post-commit accepted-window admission proven total for every prevalidated successful F-KT commit, so no expected runtime status can leave a committed physical state with missing accepted-window metadata?
How is active WOFOST binding represented sparsely so non-WOFOST columns pay no window-state allocation cost?
How are batch ordering and A-B-A replay kept deterministic?
gate_A_execution_point_and_atomicity.reason: A naive wrapper that first commits the physical runtime and only then performs fallible window admission can create a normal-error partial-composition state. Gate A must close this before implementation.

qualification_gates_after_A: rejected and retried trial zero contribution
QROT integral equals exact applied root sink sum times accepted interval duration
PTRA integral equals same-trial PTRA times accepted interval duration
not_in_scope: re-evaluation of root uptake from candidate post-state
historical multi-day B1.10 crop trajectory equivalence
oxygen IALPWET, nutrients, soybean, grass or potential crop
